deadline.value: International applicants should apply by February 1, 2027 for priority review; the standard deadline is June 1, 2027.
deadline.quote: Fall - Priority U.S. CITIZEN February 1 INTERNATIONAL February 1

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

gre_general.value: GRE General is required only if the undergraduate GPA is below 3.5 (4.0 scale); applicants at 3.5 or higher are exempt.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores (general test only) are required only if the applicant’s GPA is below 3.5 (on a 4.0 scale) in all completed undergraduate coursework

supervisor.value: Admission does not need a supervisor; the Ph.D. advisor is selected after the student is accepted.
supervisor.quote: Each student will develop a degree plan in consultation initially with the doctoral program director and, after selection, their Ph.D. advisor and committee

funding.value: Doctoral instructional and teaching assistantships are awarded on a competitive basis.
funding.quote: Doctoral instructional assistantships and teaching assistantships are offered on a competitive basis to full-time students

entry_route.value: Applicants can enter with a bachelor's in a related science or engineering field, or with a master's in one.
entry_route.quote: Baccalaureate degree in biology, chemistry, engineering, materials science, physics, technology, or a closely related field from a regionally accredited university | A master's degree in biology, chemistry, engineering, materials science, physics, technology, or a closely related field from a regionally accredited university

name: Materials Science, Engineering, and Commercialization PhD
